# The self-test's malformed catalogue. Every entry here is one way of writing a
# mutation that the checker has to refuse rather than half-accept, and each one
# has been a real mistake in a file of this shape.

  file    src/Orphan.cs

mutation noreason
  file    src/Fixture.cs
  from    Gamma = 3
  to      Gamma = 7

mutation nofrom
  file    src/Fixture.cs
  to      Delta = 6
  breaks  nothing, because it never says what to replace

mutation selfreplacing
  file    src/Fixture.cs
  from    Epsilon = 5
  to      Epsilon = 5
  breaks  nothing at all, which is the point of this entry
